Message:
“Haah, haah...!
I-I somehow...
managed to fight off
those Inquisitors...!”

“Is everyone alright...?!
...Fenrir, Cerberus...?
So yuh two are both
safe an’ sound, too...!”

I’m sorry... I’m really sorry...!
I wanted to apologize...
this whole time...!”

“Even though I could always
hear the rollin’ thunder on
that mountain in Lupus—
the very cries o’ Cerberus, I...!”

“I hated myself for only
ever shakin’ in fear...!

That’s why...I just couldn’t
stand to run away anymore...!”

“I’m sorry...! So sorry...
I-I couldn’t do anythin’ to help
the two o’ yuh back then...!”

“Finally bein’ able to
protect the two o’ yuh,
my best friends...
makes me so happy...!”

Since all three of us started
bawlin’ in each other’s arms,
our faces got all wet...
But, all our tears
felt warm, too...

Thank yuh for everything,
Great Dragon God!

Since I didn’t have the
courage to help back then,
yuh gave me
one more chance, huh...?

Thanks to yuh...
I feel like I can finally start to
like myself a little more...!
